english.title: Master of a coasting ship touched at a place outside UK / deviate from voyage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the master of a coasting ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), which, except for unavoidable cause,

(A)_[touched at a place outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..)]_
(B)_[deviated from her voyage in that **(..SPECIFY THE DEVIATION..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(1)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
